decisions.base: Keep all 330 numbered cards in one Base set with equal odds. Historical #221-330 SP frequency does not affect VCS pull likelihood.
decisions.rookies: TCDB dedicated rookie index has 57 entries. Append RC only on those 57 true Base cards.
decisions.parallels: Scorecard /2000 and Final Score /66 or less each have 330 collectibles, distinct templates.
decisions.inserts: 19 genuine insert families with their own numbers/templates. Preserve serial limit notes; only publish verified 1:N odds. Other odds null.
decisions.playerNames: Never truncate token-like characters within player names. Metadata flags may be removed only when separate words at a whitespace boundary.
decisions.pack: 4 VCS cards/pack, 24 packs/box; no artificial Base SP boosts.
decisions.release: DRAFT. Pending successful live extraction and QA of odds, pricing, imagery, team data and full review.
